is_anopheles.evidence: The paper studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Abstract, page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotypes for Vgsc L995F (kdr Leu995Phe), CYP6P3 (Glu205Asp), CYP6AA1 (Ser395Thr), CYP6AA2 (Asn327Asp), CYP6P1 (Ile168Val and Leu374Met), UGT308A2 (Lys83Asn), UGT49A3 (His226Tyr/Met172Leu), and ABCA2 (Ala147Val/Ala76Glu) (Abstract, page 1; Figure 5, page 11; Table S2.9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 5 (page 11) provides allele frequencies (%) for nonsynonymous SNPs across seven population groups.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Mangoum, Cameroon (Materials and methods, page 16).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study involving RNA-seq, bioassays, and SNP analysis of field-collected mosquitoes.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection effort spans 2020–2023 (Materials and methods, page 16).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and analyses.

supplement.evidence: The necessary data (allele frequencies) are provided in Figure 5 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the transcriptomic and genomic basis of high-intensity pyrethroid resistance in Anopheles gambiae from Mangoum, Cameroon. It integrates RNA-seq, bioassays, and SNP analysis to identify key resistance markers and pathways, highlighting the role of the CYP6Z gene family and various metabolic and target-site mutations.
